name: Rebbec
title: Architect of Ascension
summary: A celebrated Thran architect whose final choice separated Dominaria from Yawgmoth’s Phyrexia.
biography: Rebbec was one of the greatest architects of the ancient Thran civilization. She incorporated powerstones into extraordinary structures, including the floating Thran Temple above Halcyon.
When her husband Glacian fell ill, Rebbec helped bring the physician Yawgmoth to Halcyon. His growing influence contributed to the destruction of the civilization she had helped build.
Recognizing the threat posed by Phyrexia, Rebbec sealed the gateway between the planes, cutting off Yawgmoth’s immediate path back to Dominaria.

Rebbec's status in Halcyon came from her work as an architect, not from military office. Her designs expressed the Thran belief that powerstone engineering could support a spectacular public civilization. The temple and other structures matter as evidence that the empire's technological achievements were bound to political prestige and social inequality.

Her personal stake in Glacian's illness helps explain why Yawgmoth gained access to powerful circles. The decision to seek a physician came before the full danger of his program could be understood. It should not be recast as Rebbec consciously endorsing everything he later did with political influence or the artificial plane.

When Rebbec finally sealed the gateway she acted against a force she had once helped admit into her world. That choice preserved a boundary at the cost of separating her from what lay beyond it. Her historical role is thus more than that of a witness to Yawgmoth: she illustrates the limits of responsibility and the possibility of refusing a project after discovering what it had become.

featuredCard.significance: Depicts the influential Thran architect whose choices shaped Dominaria’s ancient history.
